# AutoIF-FI: audit summary

At [revision `abeaec4`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/LumiOpen/AutoIF-FI/tree/abeaec4f62f5f875810de0514176d9a5fc0506ea), we scanned **all 30,150 conversations** (30,000 train; 150 test). The Parquet SHA-256 hashes match Hugging Face's linked hashes: train `1423e7b42b0d14c7a1098d951bda20c6aea13e4dab47b65b6c93145f73e76b49`, test `9b7112de183ea83cfd02e0d298ad84a40450b12514ad74c6cc2814fa0e0b369b`.

| Main observation | Scope | Review status |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Required `.!?;:` value lost from a stored user turn | **3,006 rows (9.97%)**; 620 already in turn one; 12 test rows | Confirmed prompt/metadata mismatch; [witness](findings/ER-d9b76484.yaml) |
| Provably contradictory constraint sets under conservative count, casing, and punctuation rules | **0 rows** | Checked rule families only; other combinations remain unlabeled |
| Table-alignment verifier disagreement and no-table pass | **Row 10568** proves disagreement; 23 applicable turns in 17 rows had no table detected by one verifier | Confirmed example; [witness](findings/ER-ede7b599.yaml). The 23-turn count is a narrow review queue |
| Final answers with repeated rare-character filler such as `þþþ` or `ýýý` | **36 rows** | Confirmed text artifact ([example: train 134](https://datasets-server.huggingface.co/rows?dataset=LumiOpen%2FAutoIF-FI&config=default&split=train&offset=134&length=1)); no broad naturalness estimate |
| Test rows whose exact base query also appears in train | **16/150** | Confirmed task-level overlap ([test 24](https://datasets-server.huggingface.co/rows?dataset=LumiOpen%2FAutoIF-FI&config=default&split=test&offset=24&length=1), [train 207](https://datasets-server.huggingface.co/rows?dataset=LumiOpen%2FAutoIF-FI&config=default&split=train&offset=207&length=1)); no exact duplicate full conversations |

**Why the contradiction result differs from Dolci.** The [AutoIF pipeline](https://github.com/LumiOpen/dispatcher/tree/1c03b0194b803b82630986aaec66ca3241658ef4/examples/autoif) augments seed constraints, generates Python checkers, cross-validates them against generated cases, resolves placeholders, builds cumulative multi-turn prompts, verifies candidate answers, filters language and relevance, then keeps successful chats (favoring longer ones). This selection plausibly removes simple impossible constraint combinations; it is not proof that all remaining combinations are satisfiable. The [Dolci RL audit](../../allenai/Dolci-Think-RL-7B/README.md) found 674 impossible rows among 29,813 instruction rows; the [Dolci SFT IF audit](../../allenai/Dolci-Think-SFT-7B/README.md) found 46 paragraph-index conflicts among 358,915 IF rows. The datasets use different constraint families and selection rules, so those rates are not directly comparable.

**Where AutoIF still needs work.** The response generator checks answers against full resolved constraints, then builds the **stored SFT user text** with [`rstrip('.!?;:')`](https://github.com/LumiOpen/dispatcher/blob/1c03b0194b803b82630986aaec66ca3241658ef4/examples/autoif/src/utils/text_utils.py#L80), which removes a required value at the end of an instruction. Preserve placeholder values and validate a round trip from metadata to the saved user text before release. Generated verifier functions can disagree because [cross-validation retains a case when any function agrees](https://github.com/LumiOpen/dispatcher/blob/1c03b0194b803b82630986aaec66ca3241658ef4/examples/autoif/src/utils/cross_validator.py#L44-L53), and [answer verification rejects only when every function fails](https://github.com/LumiOpen/dispatcher/blob/1c03b0194b803b82630986aaec66ca3241658ef4/examples/autoif/tasks/responses_task.py#L345-L347). Add independently labeled positive/negative cases, reject substantive checker disagreement, and require a table when a table constraint is meant to exercise table formatting. The relevance judge is instructed to ignore constraint satisfaction, so add a separate naturalness check for character-padding artifacts. Finally, group the held-out split by base query if it is intended to test unseen tasks.

Counts are from deterministic scans of the pinned `messages`, `constraints`, and saved answers. We inspected verifier source text without executing downloaded functions. This audit does not measure model performance or establish a complete error rate for generated verifiers.
